snippet.title: [Revisited Online] Sloth vs AL (SekiZu) [Secret Training Session p1]
snippet.description:
A session training/analyzing AL p1

The connection was laggy during this one.
__________________________________________________________
SBAR: R (Shin Budokai Another Road Revisited) is a competitive mod for Shin Budokai Another Road, previously known as Double Npact.  It's not perfect but it sure is fun to play with a high skill ceiling (It be can very complex if you strive to improve).

__________________________________________________________
You can find some play sessions on the Sho Rose channel

Last recorded set - https://youtu.be/4Tc1jtDeSs0?si=HxnJN6Un_Wpl0P4w

Sho Rose channel
https://www.youtube.com/c/ShoRos%C3%A9

AL's channel
https://www.youtube.com/@UCFVFDFkt-AZHP9_Pm9xq7MA
